scope: All 143 primes p <= 10000 with p mod 24 = 1; optimize the largest of three distinct positive denominators for 4/p.

143 primes; sharp uniform z/p bound 1032; unique maximizer p=9601.
Verified regenerated table; max z/p = 1032; maximizer p=9601.

limitations: Finite prime set only: p <= 10000 and p mod 24 = 1.
